name: Tamiyo's memory scroll
description: An iron-sealed scroll holding a story of Tamiyo with her pre-compleation personality, which preserved her memory after death.

description_citations.text: "Tamiyo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's scroll is stolen and taken to Duskmourn, where Valgavoth's cultists strip her shade's memories; Nashi follows her voice and is trapped for three months.
timeline.quote: Nashi followed his mother's voice to the plane, getting trapped for three months before finally locating her.

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's shade begs Nashi to let her go, and he leaves the scroll in an Omenpath, freeing her memory in the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he left the scroll in an artificial Omenpath , freeing her memory in the Blind Eternities .

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
